To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ratio of peak load to the uniaxed tensile strength of the specimen is insensitive to the strength and the size of the specimen,but sensitive to the initial crack length.
the ratio of fictitious crack tip tensile stress to uniaxially tensile strength of normal strength concrete is approximately 1.2 and the ratio is insensitive to concrete strength.
the tensile stress of the fictitious crack model can be approximately calculated as 1.22σcu,where σcu is the uniaxual tensile strength.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the determination of the tensile strength of plain concrete based on a fictitious model,which is of significance to the study on the mechanical properties of plain concrete and the fracture mechanics of concrete.
the determination of tensile strength of normal and high strength concrete based on the fictitious crack model.
the determination of the tensile strength from the fictitious crack length of the single-edge notched specimens subjected to unaxial tensile loads.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fictitious crack model is a reasonable and effective method to determine the tensile strength of the concrete.
the tensile stress of the fictitious crack model is approximately equal to the modulus of rupture of concrete.
the ratio of tensile stress at fictitious crack tip divided by the uniaxile tensile strength of the concrete should be around the value of 1.2.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the tensile stress of fictitious crack tip can be determined by the uniaxil tensile strength of concretes and the initial crack length.
the fictitious crack model is a reasonable method to simulate the tensile behavior of concrete,but it should not be used to calculate the tensile strength of the concrete specimens.
the tensile stress is not a constant but a function of the fictitious crack length,and it is not equal to the uniaxedial tensile strength but approximately 1.2 times of the unaxial tensile strength.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we can use the fictitious crack model to determine the peak loads of single-edge notching concrete specimens subjected to tensile loads,and the fictitious crack length can be determined by the initial crack length and the uniaxed tensile strength.

the tensile stress of concrete at the fictitious tip of the initial crack can be determined by the proposed model,and the value is insensitive to the strength and initial crack length of the concrete specimens.
